title: chore(deps): bump qs to 6.16.0
body:
Bumps [qs](https://github.com/ljharb/qs) to address vulnerabilities:
- GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx (CWE-770): qs array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing
- GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g (CWE-248, CWE-703): qs: Denial of Service via Attacker Controlled isBuffer

Patches applied via pnpm overrides.
